D: Two divorce mediators crash weddings for fun, until they fall for the daughters of a powerful politician.
P: Serve the mains when the Cleary family sits down to dinner.
S: Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and chives, mini crab cakes with lemon aioli, and asparagus wrapped in prosciutto, on silver trays.
Crab meat folded with a little mayo, egg, mustard, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon.
the sailing trip that ends badly
Cooked prawns chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled into soft rolls toasted in butter on the cut sides.
M: Beef and pork mince with milk-soaked breadcrumbs, grated onion, egg and Worcestershire, shaped in a tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash.
Pan-roasted chicken breasts with a white wine, mustard and tarragon cream sauce, potato gratin and green beans.
W: every wedding they crash has one
Vanilla butter cake baked at 165C, split and layered with raspberry jam and Swiss meringue buttercream (egg whites and sugar heated to 70C, whipped, butter beaten in), served in fingers.
K: the toast at every reception they crash
Sparkling wine well chilled, poured into flutes, raised high while someone gives a speech.

s.how: Fold 400g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, celery salt, paprika and 50g breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Pan-fry in 40g butter until golden and serve with lemon.

s.note: the sailing trip that ends badly
s.how: Chop 400g cooked prawns and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter the cut sides of 4 hot dog buns and toast. Pile the prawns in.

m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Pan-roast 4 chicken breasts. Add 150ml white wine, 1 tbsp Dijon and tarragon to the pan, then 150ml cream. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.note: every wedding they crash has one
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 165C for 30 minutes. Heat 3 whites and 150g sugar to 70C, whip, then beat in 250g butter. Layer with raspberry jam and cut into fingers.

d.note: the toast at every reception they crash
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of sparkling wine for three hours. Pour into four flutes and raise them high while someone gives a speech. Crashing is optional.
